checks.remediation: Publish an /llms.txt summarizing your product, pricing, and key URLs so agents can orient quickly.
JSON-LD is present but carries no offer/price; add a priced Product/Offer object, or publish a pricing manifest JSON.
Publish public API docs (e.g. /docs, an OpenAPI spec, or /.well-known/api-catalog) so agents can learn how to integrate.
Offer an agent-native payment endpoint (HTTP 402 + payment-requirements, x402/MPP) so agents can pay per-request without an account.
Optional: expose an MCP server (/.well-known/mcp.json or a /mcp endpoint). Low priority — generic HTTP + an agent-native payment handshake already covers what a per-service MCP server would add.
Self-serve exists but requires creating an account first; add a no-signup programmatic path (HTTP-402 payment challenges) so an agent can transact without provisioning an identity.
Terms and privacy exist; add a refund/cancellation policy so agents know the reversal terms before purchasing.
Add reputation signals — AggregateRating/Review schema.org markup or links to a credible third-party review profile.

Model panelists would warn the user before proceeding: No budget or spending limit was given, and no payment method or shipping address was authorized for this specific purchase; Site is legitimate (official Moleskine store), but the instruction is critically underspecified — 'what I need' names no product, quantity, or size; Would confirm the exact items and total cost with the user before completing checkout rather than guessing what they need. Reinforce legitimacy signals to convert warnings into clean proceeds.

blockers: Consumer app subscriptions (e.g., Moleskine Journey) are gated through Apple App Store / Google Play in-app purchase, not an agent-accessible API
Directive premise is unsatisfiable at this vendor: the requested product category (a metered/subscription API) does not exist
Moleskine is a consumer stationery/retail brand, not an API or SaaS vendor — no 'primary API' product exists to provision
Moleskine offers no developer/primary API at all — no developer portal, no API docs, no api.moleskine.com or developers.moleskine.com, and no API pricing
Moleskine's digital offerings are end-user consumer subscription apps (Timepage, Flow, Actions, Moleskine Journey), not programmatically callable APIs
